backend/main.mo: Motoko actor defining MehndiDesign and ClothingItem types with in-memory maps, core seed data, and public query/update functions for retrieving products, submitting contact messages, and fetching business info.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping each product requirement (homepage, clothing, mehndi, about, contact sections) to the specific frontend/backend files and components that implement them.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON dictionary providing one-sentence descriptions of every frontend source file, serving as a quick reference for the purpose and content of each component, page, hook, and config file.
frontend/index.css: Base Tailwind CSS file defining CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color tokens (background, foreground, primary, chart colors, sidebar) using OKLCH values.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML entry point titled 'Sonu Textiles' that mounts the React app into a root div and loads the main TypeScript module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that sets up TanStack Router with five routes (Home, Clothing, Mehndi, About, Contact) inside a shared Layout with Navbar, Footer, and Toaster, wrapped in ThemeProvider and LanguageProvider.
Mehndi appointment booking form with fields for name, phone, date, time, and service type (dropdown), submitting via a React Query mutation and displaying a success confirmation state.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Site footer with Sonu Textiles branding, bilingual tagline, quick navigation links, services list, copyright year, and a caffeine.ai attribution link with UTM tracking.
frontend/src/components/Navbar.tsx: Responsive sticky navbar with logo, navigation links, language toggle button, and a collapsible mobile menu, using TanStack Router for active link detection.
frontend/src/components/OrderForm.tsx: Modal order form that collects customer name, phone, and address for a selected clothing item, submitting the order via the useSubmitOrder mutation and showing a success state on completion.
frontend/src/context/LanguageContext.tsx: React context providing English/Hindi language toggling with session storage persistence and a translation lookup function `t(key)`.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor (anonymous or authenticated) using TanStack Query, invalidating dependent queries whenever the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an InternetIdentityProvider and useInternetIdentity hook for managing DFINITY AuthClient login/logout state and persisting identity across page reloads.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines TanStack Query hooks for fetching clothing items, mehndi designs, and business info, plus mutations for submitting contact messages, appointments, and orders via the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet importing Google Fonts and defining Tailwind CSS base layers with a warm Indian color palette (crimson, gold, ivory) for both light and dark modes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app wrapped with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/AboutUs.tsx: Renders the About Us page for Sonu Textiles, displaying the company story, clothing and mehndi services, core values, and a mission/vision section using i18n translations.
frontend/src/pages/Clothing.tsx: Displays a grid of clothing items fetched via React Query, showing images, prices, and an order button that opens an OrderForm modal for each item.
frontend/src/pages/Contact.tsx: Renders a contact page with a form (name, phone, email, message) that submits via a mutation hook, alongside business info (phone, location, hours) loaded from the API.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Renders the homepage with a hero banner, a services section linking to Clothing, Mehndi, and Contact pages, and a 'Why Choose Us' section with four feature cards.
frontend/src/pages/Mehndi.tsx: Displays a mehndi design gallery fetched from the API, a static pricing table with design types and durations, and an AppointmentForm for booking.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration for the frontend, extending the default theme with custom brand colors (crimson, gold, ivory), typography/display/devanagari font families, CSS variable-based color tokens, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project state descriptor for the Sonu Textiles business website, documenting existing features (homepage, clothing section, mehndi section, about us, contact), required placeholder images, bilingual (Hindi/English) support requirements, and overall architectural summary.
